title: Runway Review (2026)
intro: Runway is evaluated here as AI software — Runway is a generative video studio (Gen-4 / Gen-4.5 and partner models) billed per editor with monthly credits. Free includes a one-time 125-credit deposit. Standard is $15/mo ($12 annual) with 625 credits; Pro $35 ($28 annual) with 2,250; Max $95 ($76 annual) with 9,500. Credits generally do not roll over except Max (one month). Explore/Unlimited was retired for new buyers in 2026. Commercial rights typically start at Pro. Enterprise is custom. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s AI methodology (ease of use, AI job fit, output quality, workflow depth, integrations, governance/privacy, scalability, value, model capability), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Runway when generative video clips are the job — not Midjourney stills and not an LLM chat.
verdict: Choose Runway when generative video clips are the job — not Midjourney stills and not an LLM chat. Compare Midjourney if stills (with some video) are enough; Firefly if Adobe video credits fit the stack. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, usage caps and credit rates on the vendor site before purchase.
